quality_test.deadline: 240 elapsed calendar days after first scheduled market recorded by the prospective collector
quality_test.settlement_grace_scope: retrieve official outcomes only for markets that started before the fixed observation deadline; no new markets or replacement sample
quality_test.bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks of 3 UTC days

secondary_metrics.brier_score: mean squared probability error on the common quality sample
secondary_metrics.calibration: mean probability minus event rate and fixed 10-bin expected calibration error; descriptive, no refit
secondary_metrics.economics: separate fixed T-60 policy replay using T-59 public books

quality_test.primary_positive: primary 95% interval is wholly below zero
quality_test.primary_negative: primary 95% interval is wholly above zero

power_planning.covered_day_definition: UTC date with at least one common paired development OOF market; zero-coverage dates remain in the resampled series and blocks

economics.policy: A_frozen at T-60 with 1% net expected-value hurdle
economics.portfolio_sensitivity: 5% of free cash, no credit, minimum order unchanged
economics.execution_time: T-59 using the same T-60 side
economics.execution_method: observed full book when recorded; otherwise explicitly labeled top-of-book proxy

data_rules.official_outcome_source: Polymarket Gamma market payload after resolved status
data_rules.websocket_startup_reconciliation: Wait up to 30 seconds for configured public feeds, then REST backfill through the latest closed candle before scheduling the first market
